title: BayesianDEB: A Bayesian Framework for Dynamic Energy Budget Modelling in R
description: An R package for Bayesian inference of Dynamic Energy Budget (DEB) models with Stan (via cmdstanr), including individual, growth-reproduction, hierarchical, and DEBtox/TKTD model types, posterior predictive checks, convergence diagnostics, LOO/WAIC comparison, and EC50/NEC inference.
